sacredAudio.title: Saututtuka Masu Tsarki da Abokan Samaniya
sacredAudio.recommendedFreqPhase: Sautin da aka shawarta ga wannan kashi
sacredAudio.scienceText1: Sautin 432 Hz sananne ne a ilmin sauti mai tsarki a matsayin tsarin halitta na Sammai. Ya bambanta da sautin zamani na 440 Hz, domin 432 Hz yana dacewa da lambar zinari, tsarin jikin dan adam da taurari.
sacredAudio.schumannBullet: 8 Hz (Motsin Schumann): Tushen sautin lantarki na Duniya.
sacredAudio.earthMultipleBullet: 432 Hz = 8 Hz x 54: Adadin bugun kashin duniya.
sacredAudio.scienceText2: Jikin dan adam yana dauke da ruwa sama da 70%. Kamar yadda Wata ke jan ruwan teku, sautin 432 Hz yana daidaita ruwan jikin dan adam. Yayin Zikiri, Tasbihi da bimbini, wannan sautin yana kwantar da bugun zuciya da kawo natsuwa (Sakinah).
sacredAudio.scienceTitle3: Ilimin Sauti da Taurarin Sama (Ilm al-Aflak)
sacredAudio.scienceText3: Manya-manyan malamai (kamar Al-Farabi a Kitab al-Musiqa al-Kabir da Ikhwan al-Safa) sun koyar da cewa sautuka 7 suna dace da taurari 7 da Manazil al-Qamar 28. Ambaton Sunayen Allah tare da sautin tauraron ranar yana daidaita zuciya da tsarin halittar Ubangiji.
sacredAudio.footerGenerator: Injin Sauti da Web Audio Synthesizer
